subject: Medford Square and West Medford Square Rezoning
overview: The committee reviewed revised draft zoning for Medford Square and West Medford Square, along with new regulations for Accessory Dwelling Units. All proposals were referred favorably to the City Council for referral to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Medford Square Zoning Proposal
items.summary: Innes Associates presented a revised map increasing height limits by right in Mixed Use districts and establishing 'daylight standards' and 45-degree angular planes to protect sunlight for abutting residential lots.

items.title: West Medford Square Zoning Proposal
items.summary: The proposal expands the square's boundaries and designates Mixed Use 2B as the primary district to incentivize housing density and improved access to the commuter rail station.

items.title: Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) Regulations
items.summary: The committee discussed draft rules to comply with new state mandates while establishing local special permit requirements for a second ADU on a single lot and larger units within historic accessory structures.

items.title: Referrals to Community Development Board
items.summary: Referred the Medford Square, West Medford Square, and ADU zoning proposals favorably to the City Council for further referral to the Community Development Board.
